Dabur India Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors in its meeting held on March 28, 2005 has approved the following:- a)Subsequent to the approval of the shareholders by way of postal ballot, it has authorized officials of the Company to implement the acquisition decision and complete the purchase of shares of three Balsara group entities namely, Balsara Hygiene Products Limited, Balsara Home Products Limited and Besta Cosmetics Limited; b)Investment of Rs.10 crore in the equity shares of Dabur Foods Limited (DFL), a wholly owned subsidiary, to enable it to acquire a manufacturing unit near Jaipur for manufacturing Fruit Juices; c)Further investment of Rs.27.66 crore in the equity shares of Balsara Home Products Limited to enable it to retire high cost borrowings; The Board of Directors, in the aforesaid meeting, also took note of the acquisition of 17.5% stake by Dabur International Limited in Dabur Nepal Private Limited (DNPL) by way of purchase from the local partners of DNPL. The Votes casted 'For' the Special Resolution No.1 and Special Resolution No.2 were 99.20% and 99.23% respectively of the total votes polled and consequently both the Special Resolutions as mentioned in the notice of Postal Ballot were passed with the requisite majority.
